```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggthemes)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = NA,
                      warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
theme_set(
  theme_gray(base_size = 17) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)))
d_spellname <- read_csv("data/spellname.csv")
d_spellname <- summarise(d_spellname,
                        rt = mean(rt), dur = mean(dur),
                        .by = c(ppt_id, name_familiarised, ppt_vocab, modality))
```

## Supplementary Materials: Customising Visualisations {.smaller}

Optional examples to explore in your own time, alongside the Week 5 theme exercise, `03_themes.Rmd`.

- Use the exercise to compare themes and practise changing individual elements.
- Use these slides as worked examples for facet labels, axis text, legends, grids, backgrounds, and facet strips.
- Choose changes that improve readability or comparison; you do not need to try every option.

These materials extend the main Week 5 session; detailed theme customisation is not required during class.

## Facet Strips Are Labels Too

<div class="plot-properties">


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(y = rt,
           x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(~modality)
```

</div>

## Facet Labels Can Come From The Data

<div class="plot-properties">


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(y = rt,
           x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(~modality,
             labeller = label_both)
```

</div>

## Recoding Changes The Data Labels

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
d_spellname <- mutate(d_spellname,
  modality = recode(modality,
    speech = "Spoken output",
    writing = "Written output"))

ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(x = dur, 
           y = rt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(~modality)
```

</div>


## Strip Labels Should Match The Story

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(y = rt,
           x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(~modality, labeller = label_both)
```

</div>




## Start From The `ggplot2` Default

<div class="plot-properties">


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(y = rt,
           x = dur)) + 
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(~modality) +
```


</div>

## Choose Themes For The Comparison {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">


- `axis`
- `legend`
- `panel`
- `plot`
- `strip`



</div>

<div class="code-plot">


## Axis Text Is Part Of Readability {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">


- `axis.text`
  - `axis.text.x`
  - `axis.text.y`
- `axis.title`
  - `axis.title.x`
  - `axis.title.y`



</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, 
       aes(y = rt,
           x = dur)) + 
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text = 
          element_text(face = "italic"))
```

</div>

- `plot.tag`


## Plot Margins Affect Readability {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">

- `plot.background`
- `plot.margin`
- `plot.title`
- `plot.subtitle`
- `plot.caption`
- `plot.tag`


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, aes(y = rt,
    x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(
    fill = "pink"),
  plot.margin = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2),
                     "cm"))
```

</div>

## Title Colour Can Help Or Hinder Readability {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">

- `plot.background`
- `plot.margin`
- `plot.title`
- `plot.subtitle`
- `plot.caption`
- `plot.tag`


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, aes(y = rt,
    x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "I'm a title") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(
    colour = "pink"))
```

</div>

## Strip Text Needs To Stay Readable {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">

- `strip.background`
- `strip.placement`
- `strip.text`


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, aes(y = rt,
    x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(~modality,
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "forestgreen"),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", hjust = 0))
```

</div>

## Combine Theme Changes Deliberately {.smaller}

<div class="plot-properties">

- `strip.background`
- `strip.placement`
- `strip.text`


</div>

<div class="code-plot">

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.width=5.4, fig.height=4.4, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(d_spellname, aes(y = rt,
    x = dur)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(~modality,
             labeller = label_both)+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "forestgreen"),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", hjust = 0, 
            face = "bold", size = 16, angle = 180))
```

</div>
